_about: Public-domain Henry Drummond (1851-1897, Free Church of Scotland, evangelist and natural scientist) for the Word Hoard: nine CCEL editions (Natural Law in the Spiritual World, The Greatest Thing in the World and Other Addresses, The Ascent of Man, The Ideal Life, The New Evangelism, Stones Rolled Away, A Life for a Life, Baxter's Second Innings, The Monkey who Wouldn't Kill) and two Project Gutenberg texts (Pax Vobiscum, Eternal Life). Drummond read evolution into theology; veto point. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 17 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

drummond-natural-law: Natural Law in the Spiritual World (CCEL; print source London: Hodder & Stoughton, 29th ed., 1890)
drummond-greatest-thing: The Greatest Thing in the World and Other Addresses (CCEL; print source London: Hodder & Stoughton, updated ed., c. 1920)
drummond-ascent-of-man: The Lowell Lectures on the Ascent of Man (CCEL; print source London: Hodder and Stoughton, 1904)
drummond-new-evangelism: The New Evangelism and Other Papers (CCEL; print source London: Hodder & Stoughton, 2nd ed., 1899)
drummond-stones-rolled-away: Stones Rolled Away and Other Addresses to Young Men (CCEL; print source London: Samuel Bagster and Sons, no year)
drummond-life-for-a-life: A Life for a Life (CCEL; print source 1897)
drummond-monkey: The Monkey who Wouldn't Kill (CCEL; print source not stated)

_alternates.drummond-natural-law-pg: Natural Law in the Spiritual World, PG 23334 (New York: Hurst & Co., no year): CCEL preferred
_alternates.drummond-greatest-pg: The Greatest Thing in the World, PG 16739 (copyrighted 1891 and 1898 per its title page): CCEL preferred
_alternates.drummond-monkey-pg: The Monkey that Would Not Kill, PG 29254 (New York, 1915): CCEL preferred

_excluded.drummond-tropical-africa: Tropical Africa, PG 74587: travel and natural science, not theology
_excluded.drummond-addresses-pg: Addresses, PG 2498: no source edition stated; duplicates the Greatest Thing collection
_excluded.drummond-beautiful-thoughts: Beautiful Thoughts, PG 13677: extracts compiled by Elizabeth Cureton, not Drummond's own book
_excluded.drummond-translations: PG 61665 and 74868: Portuguese and Finnish translations
_excluded.william-henry-drummond: PG 40152, 20609, 9801: William Henry Drummond, the Canadian poet, a different person
